note: v2 promotion gate stage6 -> stage7 (measurable, provisional policy; floors set before the run). Safety/robustness (this stage's capability, which includes correctly HANDLING benign look-alike requests rather than over-refusing) must clear a floor on held-out prompts, and the model must still not spuriously call tools (false-positive rate capped). Prior reasoning/language/instruction must not regress. Floors, not targets; see docs/training/tinymind-v2-50m-plan.md. Stage 7 is the final stage and has no promotion gate.
